d: "When nuisance alligators turn up in unexpected places, the Gator Boys are the ones called to handle the situation! From huge alligators lurking in ponds to aggressive reptiles spotted in backyards, these rescue missions take Paul Bedard, Jimmy Riffle and Ashley Lawrence across Florida and Mississippi. As experienced alligator trappers, the team is called upon to catch, remove and relocate some seriously imposing gators.
